items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where Diz got his band, was from Billy Eckstine’s band. ... Diz just – when he started that greatest band of the century, he more or less got them from Earl Hines and Billy Eckstine and King Kolax.

ctx.x: Yeah. Jug went on the road with him, and Jug never came back, because Jug went with Kolax, and then he went with Billy Eckstine.
